behaviors.behavior: Card `trg-b310add8` resolved referencing this run

Writer rejects a non-string title/detail (Stage-2 review finding 1: a non-str `detail` would otherwise write past the schema and be silently skipped WHOLE on read, discarding a co-submitted valid `title` too)
Argument validation runs BEFORE any I/O, mirroring `mark_status` (Stage-2 review finding 2)
`_resolve_tracked_only` initializes `amendedBy`/`amendedAt` for every item, not only amended ones (Stage-2 review finding 3 — shape parity with `read_all_items`)
Wire schema rejects a whitespace-only title on both `append` and `amend` branches (Stage-2 review finding 6 — closes the gap for non-Python writers)
`sweep_drift_events` glued-amend-line reason code (replaces a redundant duplicate assertion flagged by Stage-2 review finding 9)
`validate_triage_text`'s second pass reports orphan status/amend errors in FILE order, not kind-major order (Stage-2 review finding 11)
CLI notes when an amend lands in the outbox, not tracked (Stage-3 doubt review D1 — the only operator-visible delivery signal, given AC15's deferred scope)
behaviors.evidence: test_triage_cli_amend.py::test_amend_on_idle_main_notes_it_landed_in_the_outbox + ::test_amend_positional_id_happy_path's negative assertion (no note on a plain tracked write)

behaviors.behavior: Orphan amend quarantined under its OWN reason text, not a borrowed `"status"` string (Stage-3 doubt review D3)
`_resolve_tracked_only` (GC path) resolves status+amend in the same two-pass `(ts, file-order)` order as `read_all_items`, not one interleaved file-order pass (Stage-3 doubt review D4)
behaviors.evidence: test_triage_gc_amend.py::test_resolve_tracked_only_handles_an_amend_preceding_its_append_in_file_order, ::test_resolve_tracked_only_resolves_two_same_id_amends_by_ts_not_file_order (both proven to fail under the pre-fix single-pass code)
